items.title: Two charged with national security offences over RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: One of the men, Mohmed Ahmad Abdulkarim, 24, is accused of assisting Iran's intelligence service.

items.title: Pair charged over RAF Fairford incident - with suspect accused of assisting Iranian intelligence
items.summary: Two British men have been charged with national security offences following an incident at RAF Fairford last month.

items.title: Nurse treating Ebola patients killed by machete-wielding mob
items.summary: A nurse responding to the Ebola outbreak has been killed by a group of young people armed with machetes, officials have said.
